newsitem.title: PERU: Tele 2000 to raise capital by $50 mln.
newsitem.headline: Tele 2000 to raise capital by $50 mln.

text.p: Peruvian telecom Tele 2000, controlled by U.S. firm BellSouth, plans to raise its capital by $50 million through an issue of unspecified financial instruments, the Lima bolsa said Friday.
The stock exchange added in its daily report that the company's directors had approved Tele 2000's 1997 financial plan, which also includes new loans for a total $83 million.
The directors also approved the purchase of mobile telephone equipment worth $21 million with the aim of increasing and improving Tele 2000's cellular network.

Tele 2000, which operates cellular telephone and cable television services, is the second biggest telecommunications company in Peru after Spanish-owned Telefonica del Peru, which has a monopoly on conventional lines until 1998.
